base: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished high-fidelity desktop WEB APP screen, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080-like composition, straight-on interface screenshot, no physical monitor, no photographic people, no montage. FOM fleet maintenance redesigned for a busy Spanish-speaking SUPERVISOR. Operate mode: extraordinarily clear, practical, graphic, calm, professional, fully readable Spanish. Coherent shared system for ALL screens: very dark ink #090f15 background, navy graphite #131e29 surfaces, quiet #263748 hairline borders, blue #349bfa primary controls, off-white #eef4fc text, muted blue-gray #a3b4c8, restrained amber for pending and green for completed, red only warnings. Use clean humanist sans, large readable UI, generous 24-32px spacing, 10-14px corners, precise 1.5px line icons. Sidebar 210px, FOM blue pin wordmark, empresa 'Empresa de demostración', menu Resumen / Centro de control / Alertas / Vehículos / Mantenimiento [selected] / Inspecciones / Gente, footer Supervisor. Top bar company and supervisor avatar; NO Operator role, no billing. Within maintenance a single unified secondary nav 'Órdenes | Próximos servicios | Planes', currently relevant tab selected, clear breadcrumbs. Dominant one primary next action; secondary actions unobtrusive. Do not invent backend capabilities: NO drag-and-drop, AI diagnostics, automatic scheduling, payments, attachments or messaging. Visual vehicle thumbnail is illustrative, NOT a real app screen; never invent actual mobile capture. All sample operational names/values fictional and footer small 'Propuesta de diseño · Datos de demostración'. Use unit 'Unidad 08 · DEMO08', a white pickup, reported problem 'Revisar frenos delanteros', fictional responsible 'Responsable de ejemplo'. Operational stages preserve separately Abierta, En revisión, Aprobada, Asignada, En ejecución, Pausada, En calidad, Cerrada, Cancelada; display grouped stages for overview only and exact label on detail.

screens.title: Vista principal
screens.prompt: Main page 'Mantenimiento', subtitle 'Qué necesita atención y qué sigue en taller.' Primary '+ Crear orden'. Unified tabs with Órdenes active. Compact horizontal summary, NOT four huge KPI cards: 'Por revisar 1', 'En taller 0', 'Cerradas este mes 0', 'Costo registrado $65', all demonstration. Main composition: left 65% 'Necesita tu atención' ONE clear work-order row with small white pickup thumb, 'Revisar frenos delanteros', DEMO08, amber Abierta, 'Motor / frenos' use exact type 'Frenos', 'Hace 7 días', a visible blue 'Revisar orden' button. Below thin grouped state ribbon 'Abiertas 1 / En revisión 0 / En taller 0 / Cerradas 3' not giant empty kanban columns. Right 30% contextual 'Cómo avanza una orden' elegant vertical 4-step diagram Reportar, Revisar y asignar, Trabajo en taller, Revisar y cerrar, concise text. Bottom 'Últimos cierres' two restrained rows no marketing photos. Tab switch 'Prioridades | Lista' and search. Focus is the one next needed action, no fake urgency or uncomputed SLA.

Legible spacious TABLE exactly columns Orden / Unidad / Tipo / Estado / Responsable / Creada / Costo. 5 demonstration rows, white pickup tiny thumbnail plate DEMO08, titles Revisar frenos delanteros / Cambio de aceite / Revisar luces / Servicio de filtros / Revisar neumáticos. Exact states Abierta, Aprobada, En ejecución, En calidad, Cerrada. Assignment absent 'Sin asignar', costs missing 'Sin registrar'. Last column small 'Ver orden →'. Show minimal grouped counts above table. Do not use whole wall of metric cards. Bottom explanatory 'Selecciona una orden para revisar su siguiente paso.'

Si no lo conoces, déjalo vacío.' separate mandatory 'Nota del cierre' filled 'Trabajo revisado y terminado.' screens.title: Confirmar cambio de estado
screens.prompt: Centered 680px sober dialog over clear order-detail background. 'Cancelar orden' red small alert icon, title clear. Unit DEMO08 and Revisar frenos delanteros summary. Two status tokens 'En revisión → Cancelada'. Text 'La orden cancelada no admite más cambios.' Required textarea 'Motivo de cancelación' filled 'El reporte estaba duplicado.' Footer 'Volver' and restrained red 'Confirmar cancelación'. No generic Are you sure, no hidden consequence. Small summary note 'El motivo quedará en el historial'. NOT destructive delete and no trash icon. Same modal grammar is used for review/approve/reopen with blue CTA; depict only cancellation here no montage.
